selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How many paths, degrees, and truths does this passage say it will mention in a very short way?
questions.answer: It says it will mention two paths, two degrees from those paths, and two truths or details from those degrees.

questions.question: What is the first truth mainly about?
questions.answer: It is about a great ongoing activity that changes and renews everything in the heavens and the earth in an orderly way.

questions.question: What can be noticed within this wise and constant activity?
questions.answer: The rule and care of the Lord can be noticed in it.

questions.question: What is recognized within that caring and merciful rule?
questions.answer: The showing of Allah’s Divinity is recognized there.

questions.question: What do the deeds behind this activity show about the One doing them?
questions.answer: They show that the Doer has full power and complete knowledge.

questions.question: After the deeds of lordly care are noticed, what is perceived next?
questions.answer: Allah’s Names are seen through those deeds.

questions.question: After the Divine Names are understood, what comes next in the passage?
questions.answer: The seven holy attributes are understood from behind the Names.

questions.question: Name the seven attributes mentioned here.
questions.answer: Life, knowledge, power, will, hearing, sight, and speech.

questions.question: What kind of certainty does the heart of faith have about the Necessary Existent in this passage?
questions.answer: It has clear, certain, and obvious faith that He truly exists.

questions.question: How does the passage describe this Necessary Existent at the end of the first paragraph?
questions.answer: As the One God, without equal, eternal, and known by His Names and attributes.

questions.question: What does the passage say is seen all around us in the heavens and the earth?
questions.answer: A mighty, steady, organized reality of action and change is seen everywhere.

questions.question: What happens to beings within this great ongoing action?
questions.answer: They are changed, renewed, and transformed again and again.

questions.question: Why is this activity not described as random?
questions.answer: Because it is presented as wise, ordered, and full of purpose.

questions.question: What does wise activity point to first?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s lordly care and management.

questions.question: What does lordly care point to after that?
questions.answer: It points to the truth of Divinity.

questions.question: Why does the passage speak of a “veil” when talking about deeds and Names?
questions.answer: It means we understand Allah through what He does and what those actions show, even though we do not see Him with our eyes.

questions.question: What can be understood from the Divine Names shown in all things?
questions.answer: The holy attributes of Allah can be understood from them.

questions.question: According to the passage, how strong is this proof compared with the sun?
questions.answer: It is even clearer and brighter as evidence than the sun.

questions.question: What does the passage say all creation gives testimony to?
questions.answer: It testifies to the seven sacred attributes.

questions.question: What is one main lesson of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The order and wise changes in creation lead a believer to know Allah’s existence, unity, Names, and attributes.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the goal of the paths and degrees being discussed?
questions.answer: The goal is to lead a person to know Allah.

questions.question: What is the first thing the eye notices in the first truth?
questions.answer: It notices a vast and ordered activity that never stops.

questions.question: Where does this activity take place?
questions.answer: It takes place in everything on earth and in the sky.

questions.question: What does this activity reveal about the One behind it?
questions.answer: It reveals that the One behind it acts with knowledge and power.
